item.title: Nginx FAST-CGI caching, and what it bought
item.description: BackgroundIn a classic LNMP stack, PHP-FPM parses every PHP script and Nginx forwards each PHP request to it. For a busy PHP site that puts a lot of pressure on PHP-FPM — so a FastCGI cache at the Nginx layer removes most of that pressure and improves response time, at the cost of serving slightly stale pages. Nginx cache configuration1. HTTP block 1fastcgi_cache_path /tmp/cache/fastcgi_cache levels=1:2 keys_zone=fastcgi-cache:10m inactive=2d max_size=512m; 2 3fastcgi_cache_key $scheme$request_method$host$request_uri; 4proxy_buffering on; 5proxy_cache_valid any 10m; 6proxy_temp_path /tmp/cache/tmp; 7proxy_buffer_size 4k; 8proxy_buffers 100 8k; 9fastcgi_cache_lock on; 10fastcgi_cache_use_stale error timeout invalid_header updating http_500; 11fastcgi_ignore_headers Cache-Control Expires Set-Cookie; keys_zone=fastcgi-cache is the zone the server block below refers to.
